svg.title: Open-BioAFE floorplan concept: input pads and channel strips at one edge, shared analog in the middle, digital behind a guard ring at the opposite edge
svg.text: Microvolts at one edge, clocks at the other (concept, core to scale)
Core about 1.6 × 1.06 mm ≈ 1.7 mm² (Section 29.3), drawn to scale: the eight strips take two thirds of it. Pad count and positions are illustrative.
blue: analog · gold: digital · green: guard ring · gold pads: signals · grey pads: supplies
